## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- Data drift detection
- Canary deployment
- Feature store integration
- Observability and SLOs
- Safe rollback policies

## Code Example
```python
import math

def kl_div(p, q):
    return sum(pi * math.log(pi/qi) for pi, qi in zip(p, q) if pi > 0 and qi > 0)

def drift_exceeds(p, q, thr=0.1):
    return kl_div(p, q) > thr
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you automate rollback when drift or latency thresholds are breached?
- What tests ensure user data privacy during shadow/live testing?

## Testing Strategy Layers

### Unit Testing
- Fast feedback loops with Jest/Vitest
- Mock external dependencies
- Target 80%+ code coverage

### Integration Testing
- Validate service boundaries
- Test database interactions
- Verify message queue flows

### Contract Testing
- Consumer-driven contracts with Pact
- Prevent breaking changes
- Automated verification in CI

### Performance Testing
- Load testing with k6
- Stress testing scenarios
- Capacity planning benchmarks

### Chaos Engineering
- Simulate failures with Gremlin
- Test recovery mechanisms
- Improve system resilience

## CI/CD Optimization

- Parallel test execution
- Test result caching
